topic: Levels of Biological Organization from Cell to Biosphere
key_concepts: Living things are highly organized and structured from small to large scales
The biological levels are cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism, population, communi
The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life
Tissues are groups of specialized cells that perform specific functions
Organs are groups of two or more different tissues performing a specific function
Organ systems are groups of organs working together to perform one or more functions
An organism is an individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form
A population is a group of organisms of the same species living in the same area
A community is composed of different populations living in a particular area
An ecosystem includes biotic and abiotic factors interacting with each other
The biosphere is the sum of all ecosystems on Earth and the largest level
